 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER These M.Cr.Cs being related with same crime number are decided analogously.

These are the first bail applications filed by the applicants under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.84/2023 dated 23.02.2023 registered at P o lic e Station Govindpura, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 120-B of IPC and Section 3/4 of M.P. recognized Examinations Act, 1937.
Learned counsels for the applicants submit that applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the case.

It is also submitted that the applicants are in custody since 22.03.2023 and trial will take considerable time to conclude; that applicants are permanent residents of the district and there is no likelihood of their absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence; that the applicants are ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
On these grounds, it is prayed that the applicants may be released on bail.
Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

According to prosecution, applicants Amit Kumar and Jyoti Chore were involved in crime related to examination under which Jyoti Chore misrepresented herself as candidate Kavita Kumari and gave examination in her place.

For facilitating this crime,
applicant Amit Kumar provided a forged admit card to applicant Jyoti Chore issued in the name of Kavita and bearing a fake seal.
Applicant Jyoti Chore was caught at examination center and CCTV footage showing her involvement has been seized in the matter.
It is claimed by her that her young daughter is alongwith her in the jail.
Looking to the fact that her custody is not required any more for the purposes of investigation, her application deserves to be allowed.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, application of applicant Jyoti Chore is allowed.

Regarding the bail application of applicant Amit Kumar, it has been stated by the prosecution that present applicant is a member of a large racket and arrest of other persons involved in the crime is still to be made.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the application of Amit Kumar is rejected.
However, he will be at liberty to file a fresh bail application after the submission of charge-sheet.

It is directed that the applicant Jyoti Chore shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
